arc.fallback: Great Sea Battle of Kirigakure Arc

description.fallback: Boruto almost falls into the ocean again, concerned he won't be saved again, and still puzzled by the person with webbed hands. Ikada warns him they're about to enter more turbulent, stormy waters. Boruto compliments Ikada on his skills, and Ikada reveals he was born on the sea and lived on a boat since he was little.
